title: dactylis glomerata subsp. woronowii
intro: Dactylis glomerata subsp. woronowii, commonly known as Orchard Grass, is a subspecies of the Dactylis glomerata plant, a type of grass native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and supporting respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Dactylis glomerata subsp. woronowii include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which may contribute to its use in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
